name: Borders
description: A collection of Border objects that represent the borders of an object.
remarks: Use the Borders property to return the Borders collection. The following example applies the default border around the first paragraph in the active document. Border objects cannot be added to the Borders collection. The number of members in the Borders collection is finite and varies depending on the type of object. For example, a table has six elements in the Borders collection, whereas a paragraph has four. Use Borders (index), where index identifies the border, to return a single Border object. Index can be one of the WdBorderType constants. Some of the WdBorderType constants may not be available to you, depending on the language support (U.S. English, for example) that you have selected or installed. Use the LineStyle property to apply a border line to a Border object. The following example applies a double-line border below the first paragraph in the active document. The following example applies a single-line border around the first character in the selection. The following example adds an art border around each page in the first section.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified Borders collection.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Returns the number of items in the Borders collection. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Enable
properties.description: Returns or sets border formatting for the specified object. Read/write Long.

properties.name: DistanceFromTop
properties.description: Returns or sets the space (in points) between the text and the top border. Read/write Long.

properties.name: Shadow
properties.description: True if the specified border is formatted as shadowed. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: InsideLineStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the inside border for the specified object. .

properties.name: OutsideLineStyle
properties.description: Returns or sets the outside border for the specified object. .

properties.name: InsideLineWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets the line width of the inside border of an object. .

properties.name: OutsideLineWidth
properties.description: Returns or sets the line width of the outside border of an object. Read/write.

properties.name: InsideColorIndex
properties.description: Returns or sets the color of the inside borders. Read/write WdColorIndex.

properties.name: OutsideColorIndex
properties.description: Returns or sets the color of the outside borders. Read/write WdColorIndex.

properties.name: DistanceFromLeft
properties.description: Returns or sets the space (in points) between the text and the left border. Read/write Long.

properties.name: DistanceFromBottom
properties.description: Returns or sets the space (in points) between the text and the bottom border. Read/write Long.

properties.name: DistanceFromRight
properties.description: Returns or sets the space (in points) between the right edge of the text and the right border. Read/write Long.

properties.name: AlwaysInFront
properties.description: True if page borders are displayed in front of the document text. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: SurroundHeader
properties.description: True if a page border encompasses the document header. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: SurroundFooter
properties.description: True if a page border encompasses the document footer. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: JoinBorders
properties.description: True if vertical borders at the edges of paragraphs and tables are removed so that the horizontal borders can connect to the page border. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: HasHorizontal
properties.description: True if a horizontal border can be applied to the object. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: HasVertical
properties.description: True if a vertical border can be applied to the specified object. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: DistanceFrom
properties.description: Returns or sets a value that indicates whether the specified page border is measured from the edge of the page or from the text it surrounds. Read/write WdBorderDistanceFrom.

properties.name: EnableFirstPageInSection
properties.description: True if page borders are enabled for the first page in the section. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: EnableOtherPagesInSection
properties.description: True if page borders are enabled for all pages in the section except for the first page. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: InsideColor
properties.description: Returns or sets the 24-bit color of the inside borders. Read/write.

properties.name: OutsideColor
properties.description: Returns or sets the 24-bit color of the outside borders. .

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Returns a border in a range or selection.

methods.name: ApplyPageBordersToAllSections
methods.description: Applies the specified page-border formatting to all sections in a document.
